digest.component_or_area: local developer gates and LLM provider configuration
propositions: local developer gates must be configured to resolve model classes to Bedrock inference profiles instead of direct Anthropic endpoints for pre-production validation
prompt caching must engage on the Bedrock path with nonzero cache_read_tokens, not only cache_write, to prove functional cache behavior
all three developer gates (review-plan, review-code, verify-completion) must execute end-to-end against Bedrock with structured output validation and zero direct-Anthropic calls
Bedrock cachePoint TTL defaults to 5 minutes matching Anthropic cache_control, eliminating the supposed TTL difference as an observable issue
configuration opt-in and revert must be documented and executable in a single environment variable change without infra/ modifications
